root_cause: Upgrading pyjwt from 2.8.0 to 3.0.0 removed the PyJWT import used by auth/tokens.py, so the integration tests failed at import time and the release was blocked. Production is unaffected.
contributing_factors: Code still imports the removed PyJWT name
Dependency pinned by major version without compatibility check

remediation.recommendation: Pin pyjwt below 3.0 or migrate auth/tokens.py to the 3.x API
